FINAL ACCOUNTABILITY REQUEST

For IVX IA Senior Developer and Autonomous:

Do not compare them to earlier certifications.

Compare them to the current repository.

For each missing capability provide:

1. Feature name
2. Current file(s)
3. Current implementation
4. Exact missing code
5. Exact missing function/class/API
6. Estimated lines of code required
7. Estimated engineering time
8. Whether the missing work is:
   - bug fix
   - incomplete implementation
   - missing integration
   - missing deployment
   - missing runtime permission
   - missing test
9. Produce a prioritized completion plan.

Do not say "premature" or "not the same as Rork."

Show exactly what code is missing and what must be implemented to make IVX IA Senior Developer production-ready.,OWNER CONTROL REQUIREMENT — EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY

Beginning now, all production work must be completed under my ownership and control.

The canonical production source of truth is:

GitHub Owner:
ibb142

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

All deployments must originate from my GitHub repository and my approved production branch.

No Rork-owned repository, personal repository, temporary repository, hidden branch, private fork, or alternate deployment source may be used.

Production ownership must remain under my accounts:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AWS
- Domain/DNS
- Android signing credentials
- Apple Developer account (when iOS is released)

Any automation performed by Rork must execute only through my authorized project integrations and must not create or depend on Rork-owned infrastructure.

Before every production deployment, verify:

- GitHub HEAD is my repository.
- Render is connected to my repository.
- The deployed SHA matches my GitHub HEAD.
- The live /version endpoint reports the same SHA.

After every deployment, return:

- GitHub repository
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Live /version SHA
- SHA parity confirmation

From this point forward, all production releases, deployments, and engineering work must remain under my owner-controlled infrastructure. No ownership transfer, deployment source change, or new production dependency may be introduced without my explicit approval.
